description: Header file defining CUDA kernel templates and utility functions for various probability distributions in PyTorch's ATen library, including random number generation kernels for distributions like normal, uniform, log-normal, geometric, exponential, cauchy, and Bernoulli.

methods.name: calc_execution_policy
methods.description: Calculates grid and block dimensions and philox offset for CUDA distribution kernels based on total elements and unroll factor.

methods.name: distribution_elementwise_grid_stride_kernel
methods.description: CUDA kernel for distribution sampling using grid-stride loop, supports unroll factor.

methods.name: distribution_nullary_kernel
methods.description: Launches distribution kernels with support for TensorIterator, handles 1D and multi-dimensional tensors.

methods.name: distribution_binary_kernel
methods.description: CUDA kernel for binary distribution operations, e.g., sampling from a distribution conditioned on two inputs.

methods.name: random_from_to_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for generating random integers within a range, with special handling for full 64-bit range.

methods.name: random_full_64_bits_range_kernel
methods.description: Special kernel for generating 64-bit range random integers.

methods.name: random_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for generating uniform random integers.

methods.name: normal_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for generating normally distributed random numbers.

methods.name: uniform_and_transform
methods.description: Generates uniform distribution samples and applies a transformation.

methods.name: normal_and_transform
methods.description: Generates normal distribution samples and applies a transformation.

methods.name: log_normal_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for generating log-normal distributed random numbers.

methods.name: geometric_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for generating geometric distribution samples.

methods.name: exponential_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for generating exponential distribution samples.

methods.name: cauchy_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for generating Cauchy distribution samples.

methods.name: bernoulli_tensor_cuda_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for Bernoulli distribution sampling with tensor probabilities.

methods.name: bernoulli_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for Bernoulli sampling with scalar probability.
